          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 672
          },
          {
            "text": "9. Beta testing (dogfood)",
            "lineNumber": 673
          },
          {
            "text": "10. Telemetry analysis",
            "lineNumber": 674
          },
          {
            "text": "11. Documentation review",
            "lineNumber": 675
          },
          {
            "text": "12. Release announcement",
            "lineNumber": 676
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 678
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 679
          },
          {
            "text": "## 💡 教訓",
            "lineNumber": 680
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 681
          },
          {
            "text": "### うまくいったこと",
            "lineNumber": 682
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 683
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **モジュール分離**: blueprint, telemetry, webhooksを完全分離 → テスト・保守が容易",
            "lineNumber": 684
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Type-safe State Machine**: Enum with dataでコンパイル時検証",
            "lineNumber": 685
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Dual Format Persistence**: MD (human) + JSON (machine) → 両方の利点",
            "lineNumber": 686
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Privacy by Design**: 最初からhashing組み込み → 後付け不要",
            "lineNumber": 687
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Embedded Unit Tests**: 各moduleに tests → coverage高い",
            "lineNumber": 688
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 689
          },
          {
            "text": "### 改善点",
            "lineNumber": 690
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 691
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Stub実装多め**: RPC handlersが現時点でstub → Phase 10で実装必要",
            "lineNumber": 692
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Integration Tests後回し**: Unit first → integration後 (正しいが時間かかる)",
            "lineNumber": 693
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.42195388674736023

        "contents": "|------|------|------|\n| **起動速度** | &lt; 1秒 | ~0.5秒 ✅ |\n| **タスク成功率** | &gt; 90% | シミュレーション 🔴 |\n| **トークン効率** | &lt; 50k/タスク | 未測定 🔴 |\n\n---\n\n## 🐛 既知の課題（次回対応）\n\n### Deep Research\n\n1. **DuckDuckGo 202エラー**\n   - 現状: フォールバックで対応\n   - 目標: 実検索結果取得\n   - 優先度: 🔴 高\n\n2. **scraperクレート完全移行**\n   - 現状: 部分的統合\n   - 目標: regex完全削除\n   - 優先度: 🔴 高\n\n3. **引用検証機能**\n   - 現状: 未実装\n   - 目標: URL到達性・整合性チェック\n   - 優先度: 🟡 中\n\n### サブエージェント\n\n1. **実行エンジン未実装**\n   - 現状: シミュレーションのみ\n   - 目標: AgentRuntime実装\n   - 優先度: 🔴 高\n\n2. **権限管理未実装**\n   - 現状: YAML定義のみ\n   - 目標: 実行時チェック\n   - 優先度: 🔴 高\n\n3. **MCPツール連携**\n   - 現状: 未実装\n   - 目標: ツール呼び出し機構\n   - 優先度: 🟡 中\n\n---\n\n## 💡 アイデアメモ（将来の拡張）\n\n### Phase 2: Enhanced Deep Research\n- [ ] 多言語検索対応（日本語、中国語、etc.）\n- [ ] 画像検索統合\n- [ ] 動画検索統合\n- [ ] 学術論文検索（arXiv, Google Scholar）\n- [ ] リアルタイムニュース検索\n\n### Phase 3: Advanced Sub-Agents\n- [ ] マルチエージェント協調（複数エージェント並列実行）\n- [ ] エージェント学習（過去タスクから学習）\n- [ ] カスタムエージェント作成UI\n- [ ] エージェントマーケットプレイス\n\n### Phase 4: Enterprise Features\n- [ ] チーム共有機能\n- [ ] 監査ログ永続化\n- [ ] コスト管理ダッシュボード\n- [ ] SSO/RBAC統合\n\n---\n\n## 🎓 参考リソース\n\n### 公式ドキュメント\n- [Rust Book](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/)\n- [Tokio Documentation](https://tokio.rs/)\n- [Serde Documentation](https://serde.rs/)\n- [scraper Documentation](https://docs.rs/scraper/)",

        "contents": "impl Tokenizer {\n    /// Build a tokenizer for a specific encoding.\n    pub fn new(kind: EncodingKind) -&gt; Result&lt;Self, TokenizerError&gt; {\n        let loader: fn() -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;CoreBPE&gt; = match kind {\n            EncodingKind::O200kBase =&gt; tiktoken_rs::o200k_base,\n            EncodingKind::Cl100kBase =&gt; tiktoken_rs::cl100k_base,\n        };\n\n        let inner = loader().map_err(|source| TokenizerError::LoadEncoding { kind, source })?;\n        Ok(Self { inner })\n    }\n\n    /// Default to &#96;O200kBase&#96;\n    pub fn try_default() -&gt; Result&lt;Self, TokenizerError&gt; {\n        Self::new(EncodingKind::O200kBase)\n    }\n\n    /// Build a tokenizer using an &#96;OpenAI&#96; model name (maps to an encoding).\n    /// Falls back to the &#96;O200kBase&#96; encoding when the model is unknown.\n    pub fn for_model(model: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Self, TokenizerError&gt; {\n        match tiktoken_rs::get_bpe_from_model(model) {\n            Ok(inner) =&gt; Ok(Self { inner }),\n            Err(model_error) =&gt; {\n                let inner = tiktoken_rs::o200k_base()\n                    .with_context(|| {\n                        format!(\"fallback after model lookup failure for {model}: {model_error}\")\n                    })\n                    .map_err(|source| TokenizerError::LoadEncoding {\n                        kind: EncodingKind::O200kBase,\n                        source,\n                    })?;\n                Ok(Self { inner })\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Encode text to token IDs. If &#96;with_special_tokens&#96; is true, special\n    /// tokens are allowed and may appear in the result.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn encode(&amp;self, text: &amp;str, with_special_tokens: bool) -&gt; Vec&lt;i32&gt; {\n        let raw = if with_special_tokens {\n            self.inner.encode_with_special_tokens(text)\n        } else {\n            self.inner.encode_ordinary(text)\n        };\n        raw.into_iter().map(|t| t as i32).collect()\n    }\n\n    /// Count tokens in &#96;text&#96; as a signed integer.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn count(&amp;self, text: &amp;str) -&gt; i64 {\n        // Signed length to satisfy our style preference.",

        "contents": "    pub fn count(&amp;self, text: &amp;str) -&gt; i64 {\n        // Signed length to satisfy our style preference.\n        i64::try_from(self.inner.encode_ordinary(text).len()).unwrap_or(i64::MAX)\n    }\n\n    /// Decode token IDs back to text.\n    pub fn decode(&amp;self, tokens: &amp;[i32]) -&gt; Result&lt;String, TokenizerError&gt; {\n        let raw: Vec&lt;u32&gt; = tokens.iter().map(|t| *t as u32).collect();\n        self.inner\n            .decode(raw)\n            .map_err(|source| TokenizerError::Decode { source })\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use pretty_assertions::assert_eq;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn cl100k_base_roundtrip_simple() -&gt; Result&lt;(), TokenizerError&gt; {\n        let tok = Tokenizer::new(EncodingKind::Cl100kBase)?;\n        let s = \"hello world\";\n        let ids = tok.encode(s, false);\n        // Stable expectation for cl100k_base\n        assert_eq!(ids, vec![15339, 1917]);\n        let back = tok.decode(&amp;ids)?;\n        assert_eq!(back, s);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn preserves_whitespace_and_special_tokens_flag() -&gt; Result&lt;(), TokenizerError&gt; {\n        let tok = Tokenizer::new(EncodingKind::Cl100kBase)?;\n        let s = \"This  has   multiple   spaces\";\n        let ids_no_special = tok.encode(s, false);\n        let round = tok.decode(&amp;ids_no_special)?;\n        assert_eq!(round, s);\n\n        // With special tokens allowed, result may be identical for normal text,\n        // but the API should still function.\n        let ids_with_special = tok.encode(s, true);\n        let round2 = tok.decode(&amp;ids_with_special)?;\n        assert_eq!(round2, s);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn model_mapping_builds_tokenizer() -&gt; Result&lt;(), TokenizerError&gt; {\n        // Choose a long-standing model alias that maps to cl100k_base.",

        "contents": "//!         "contents": "//! Organization management system\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse sqlx::Row;\nuse sqlx::sqlite::SqlitePool;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::SystemTime;\nuse tracing::info;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse crate::organizations::schema::Member;\nuse crate::organizations::schema::Organization;\n\n/// Organization manager\npub struct OrganizationManager {\n    /// Database connection pool\n    pub pool: Arc&lt;SqlitePool&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl OrganizationManager {\n    /// Create a new organization manager\n    pub async fn new(database_path: PathBuf) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        // Ensure parent directory exists\n        if let Some(parent) = database_path.parent() {\n            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n        }\n\n        let database_url = format!(\"sqlite:{}\", database_path.display());\n        let pool = SqlitePool::connect(&amp;database_url)\n            .await\n            .context(\"Failed to connect to database\")?;\n\n        // Initialize schema\n        sqlx::query(\n            r#\"\n            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS organizations (\n                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                name TEXT NOT NULL,\n                description TEXT,\n                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n            )\n            \"#,\n        )\n        .execute(&amp;pool)\n        .await?;\n\n        sqlx::query(\n            r#\"\n            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS members (\n                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n                user_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n                role TEXT NOT NULL,\n                joined_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n                FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id)\n            )\n            \"#,\n        )\n        .execute(&amp;pool)\n        .await?;\n\n        sqlx::query(\n            r#\"\n            ",

        "contents": "//! Worktree competition for multi-variant execution\n//!\n//! Creates multiple git worktrees, executes identical tasks in parallel,\n//! scores results, and auto-merges the winner.\n\nuse crate::plan::schema::EvalCriteria;\nuse crate::plan::schema::PlanBlock;\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Command;\nuse tracing::debug;\nuse tracing::info;\nuse tracing::warn;\n\n/// Competition configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct CompetitionConfig {\n    /// Number of variants to run (2-3 recommended)\n    pub num_variants: usize,\n\n    /// Scoring weights\n    pub weights: ScoreWeights,\n\n    /// Time budget in minutes\n    pub time_budget_min: u64,\n\n    /// Base directory for worktrees\n    pub worktree_base: PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl Default for CompetitionConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            num_variants: 2,\n            weights: ScoreWeights::default(),\n            time_budget_min: 30,\n            worktree_base: PathBuf::from(\".codex/worktrees\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Scoring weights for competition variants\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ScoreWeights {\n    /// Weight for test results (0.0-1.0)\n    pub tests: f64,\n\n    /// Weight for performance (0.0-1.0)\n    pub performance: f64,\n\n    /// Weight for code simplicity (0.0-1.0)\n    pub simplicity: f64,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ScoreWeights {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            tests: 0.5,\n            performance: 0.3,\n            simplicity: 0.2,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// A single competition variant\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct CompetitionVariant {\n    /// Variant name (A, B, C, etc.)",

        "contents": "//! Virtual OS Layer\n//!\n//! Provides virtualization layer for running applications in isolated environments\n//! with macOS-style UI/UX, application creation interface, and internet connectivity.\n\npub mod app_creator;\npub mod macos_emulator;\npub mod network;\npub mod terminal;\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\n\n/// Virtual OS layer trait\npub trait VirtualOSLayer {\n    /// Initialize the virtual OS layer\n    fn initialize(&amp;mut self) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt;;\n\n    /// Shutdown the virtual OS layer\n    fn shutdown(&amp;mut self) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt;;\n\n    /// Get the virtual OS type\n    fn os_type(&amp;self) -&gt; VirtualOSType;\n\n    /// Check if the virtual OS is running\n    fn is_running(&amp;self) -&gt; bool;\n}\n\n/// Virtual OS types\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum VirtualOSType {\n    MacOS,\n    Linux,\n    Windows,\n}\n\n/// Virtual OS configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct VirtualOSConfig {\n    /// OS type\n    pub os_type: VirtualOSType,\n    /// Workspace directory\n    pub workspace_path: PathBuf,\n    /// Enable network access\n    pub enable_network: bool,\n    /// Memory limit in MB\n    pub memory_mb: usize,\n    /// CPU count\n    pub cpu_count: usize,\n    /// Enable GPU access\n    pub enable_gpu: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for VirtualOSConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            os_type: VirtualOSType::MacOS,\n            workspace_path: PathBuf::from(\"./virtual-os-workspace\"),\n            enable_network: true,\n            memory_mb: 4096,\n            cpu_count: 4,\n            enable_gpu: false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Virtual OS instance\npub struct VirtualOSInstance {\n    /// Instance ID\n    pub id: String,\n    /// OS type\n    pub os_type: VirtualOSType,\n    /// Configuration\n    pub config: VirtualOSConfig,\n    /// Is running\n    pub is_running: bool,\n}\n\nimpl VirtualOSInstance {\n    pub fn new(config: VirtualOSConfig) -&gt; Self",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\mcp-server\\src\\codex_tools\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 77
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Codex Tools Module\n\nThis directory contains Codex-specific MCP tool definitions for sub-agent delegation.\n\n## Overview\n\nCodex Tools provide a set of MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools that allow sub-agents to interact with Codex capabilities safely and efficiently.\n\n## Tool Categories\n\n### 1. Safe (Read-Only) Tools\n\nThese tools are safe to use without requiring additional permissions:\n\n- **&#96;read_file&#96;** - Read files from the workspace\n- **&#96;grep&#96;** - Search for patterns in files using regex\n- **&#96;codebase_search&#96;** - Semantic code search using AI\n\n### 2. Write Tools\n\nThese tools require write permissions:\n\n- **&#96;apply_patch&#96;** - Apply unified diff patches to files\n\n### 3. Shell Tools\n\nThese tools require shell execution permissions:\n\n- **&#96;shell&#96;** - Execute shell commands (restricted, requires approval)\n\n## Module Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ncodex_tools/\n├── mod.rs              # Main module definition\n├── read_file.rs        # Read file tool\n├── grep.rs             # Grep search tool\n├── codebase_search.rs  # Semantic search tool\n├── apply_patch.rs      # Patch application tool\n├── shell.rs            # Shell command tool\n└── README.md           # This file\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Usage\n\n### Getting Safe Tools\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nuse codex_mcp_server::codex_tools::CodexMcpTool;\n\nlet safe_tools = CodexMcpTool::safe_tools();\n// Returns: [read_file, grep, codebase_search]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Getting All Tools\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nlet all_tools = CodexMcpTool::all_tools();\n// Returns: [read_file, grep, codebase_search, apply_patch, shell]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Tool Schema\n\nEach tool follows the MCP tool schema:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub struct CodexMcpTool {\n    pub name: String,           // Tool identifier (e.g., \"codex_read_file\")\n    pub description: String,    // Human-readable description\n    pub input_schema: Value,    // JSON Schema for input validation\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Security Model\n\n- **Read-Only Tools**: No approval required, safe by default\n- **Write Tools**: Require sandbox mode &#96;workspace-write&#96; or higher",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Tools Module",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "This directory contains Codex-specific MCP tool definitions for sub-agent delegation.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex Tools provide a set of MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools that allow sub-agents to interact with Codex capabilities safely and efficiently.",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## Tool Categories",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Safe (Read-Only) Tools",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "These tools are safe to use without requiring additional permissions:",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- **&#96;read_file&#96;** - Read files from the workspace",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- **&#96;grep&#96;** - Search for patterns in files using regex",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- **&#96;codebase_search&#96;** - Semantic code search using AI",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. Write Tools",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "These tools require write permissions:",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **&#96;apply_patch&#96;** - Apply unified diff patches to files",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. Shell Tools",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "These tools require shell execution permissions:",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- **&#96;shell&#96;** - Execute shell commands (restricted, requires approval)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "## Module Structure",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "codex_tools/",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "├── mod.rs              # Main module definition",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "├── read_file.rs        # Read file tool",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "├── grep.rs             # Grep search tool",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "├── codebase_search.rs  # Semantic search tool",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "├── apply_patch.rs      # Patch application tool",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "├── shell.rs            # Shell command tool",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "└── README.md           # This file",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "## Usage",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "### Getting Safe Tools",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_mcp_server::codex_tools::CodexMcpTool;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "let safe_tools = CodexMcpTool::safe_tools();",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "// Returns: [read_file, grep, codebase_search]",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "### Getting All Tools",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "let all_tools = CodexMcpTool::all_tools();",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "// Returns: [read_file, grep, codebase_search, apply_patch, shell]",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "## Tool Schema",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "Each tool follows the MCP tool schema:",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct CodexMcpTool {",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub name: String,           // Tool identifier (e.g., \"codex_read_file\")",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub description: String,    // Human-readable description",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub input_schema: Value,    // JSON Schema for input validation",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "## Security Model",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Read-Only Tools**: No approval required, safe by default",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Write Tools**: Require sandbox mode &#96;workspace-write&#96; or higher",
            "lineNumber": 77
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3259880542755127

        "contents": "//! Plan schema definitions\n//!\n//! Defines the core data structures for plan mode, including the\n//! PlanBlock which represents a complete planning artifact.\n\nuse chrono::DateTime;\nuse chrono::Utc;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\n\n/// Execution mode for Plan execution\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"snake_case\")]\npub enum ExecutionMode {\n    /// Single agent, no orchestration\n    Single,\n    /// Orchestrated control with central planner + sub-agents\n    Orchestrated,\n    /// Worktree competition with multiple variants\n    Competition,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ExecutionMode {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::Orchestrated\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ExecutionMode {\n    fn fmt(&amp;self, f: &amp;mut std::fmt::Formatter&lt;'_&gt;) -&gt; std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            Self::Single =&gt; write!(f, \"single\"),\n            Self::Orchestrated =&gt; write!(f, \"orchestrated\"),\n            Self::Competition =&gt; write!(f, \"competition\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// A single work item in the Plan\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct WorkItem {\n    /// Work item name\n    pub name: String,\n    /// Files that will be touched\n    pub files_touched: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Diff contract (patch, full, etc.)\n    pub diff_contract: String,\n    /// Required tests\n    pub tests: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n/// A risk item with mitigation strategy\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Risk {\n    /// Risk description\n    pub item: String,\n    /// Mitigation strategy\n    pub mitigation: String,\n}\n\n/// Evaluation criteria for the Plan\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]\npub struct EvalCriteria {\n    /// Tests that must pass\n    pub tests: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Performance metrics and thresholds\n    pub metrics: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Budget constraints for execution\n#[",

        "contents": "//! Development mode selection and history analysis\n//!\n//! Provides functionality to select between central orchestration and git worktree\n//! parallel development modes, with support for analyzing past implementation logs\n//! and commit history.\n\nuse crate::orchestration::conflict_resolver::MergeStrategy;\nuse crate::plan::ExecutionMode;\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse chrono::DateTime;\nuse chrono::Utc;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Command;\nuse tracing::debug;\nuse tracing::info;\nuse tracing::warn;\n\n/// Development mode configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"snake_case\")]\npub enum DevelopmentMode {\n    /// Central orchestration with conflict resolution\n    /// Uses ConflictResolver for deadlock and conflict prevention\n    Central {\n        /// Merge strategy for conflict resolution\n        merge_strategy: MergeStrategy,\n        /// Enable dynamic conflict detection\n        dynamic_conflict_detection: bool,\n        /// Enable QC agent for quality analysis\n        enable_qc: bool,\n    },\n    /// Git worktree parallel development\n    /// Uses WorktreeManager for isolated parallel development\n    Worktree {\n        /// Number of parallel worktrees\n        num_worktrees: usize,\n        /// Auto-merge winner after competition\n        auto_merge_winner: bool,\n        /// Enable QC agent for quality analysis\n        enable_qc: bool,\n    },\n}\n\nimpl Default for DevelopmentMode {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::Central {\n            merge_strategy: MergeStrategy::ThreeWayMerge,\n            dynamic_conflict_detection: true,\n            enable_qc: true,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl DevelopmentMode {\n    /// Convert to plan execution mode.",

        "contents": "pub struct CompetitionVariant {\n    /// Variant name (A, B, C, etc.)\n    pub name: String,\n\n    /// Branch name\n    pub branch: String,\n\n    /// Worktree path\n    pub worktree_path: PathBuf,\n\n    /// Score breakdown\n    pub score: CompetitionScore,\n}\n\n/// Competition score breakdown\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct CompetitionScore {\n    /// Test score (0.0-100.0)\n    pub tests: f64,\n\n    /// Performance score (0.0-100.0)\n    pub performance: f64,\n\n    /// Simplicity score (0.0-100.0)\n    pub simplicity: f64,\n\n    /// Weighted total score\n    pub total: f64,\n\n    /// Whether this is the winning variant\n    pub is_winner: bool,\n}\n\nimpl CompetitionScore {\n    /// Create a new score\n    pub fn new(tests: f64, performance: f64, simplicity: f64, weights: &amp;ScoreWeights) -&gt; Self {\n        let total = tests * weights.tests\n            + performance * weights.performance\n            + simplicity * weights.simplicity;\n\n        Self {\n            tests,\n            performance,\n            simplicity,\n            total,\n            is_winner: false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Mark as winner\n    pub fn mark_winner(&amp;mut self) {\n        self.is_winner = true;\n    }\n}\n\n/// Competition result\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct CompetitionResult {\n    /// All variants\n    pub variants: Vec&lt;CompetitionVariant&gt;,\n\n    /// Winner variant name\n    pub winner: String,\n\n    /// Comparison table (human-readable)\n    pub comparison_table: String,\n\n    /// Total execution time in seconds\n    pub execution_time_secs: f64,\n}\n\n/// Worktree manager\npub struct WorktreeManager {\n    /// Repository root\n    repo_root: PathBuf,\n\n    /// Base directory for worktrees\n    worktree_base: PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl WorktreeManager {\n    /// Create a new worktree manager",

        "contents": "impl AgentRuntime {\n    /// Codexバイナリパスを設定\n    pub fn with_codex_binary_path(mut self, path: PathBuf) -&gt; Self {\n        self.codex_binary_path = Some(path);\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// 協調ストアへの参照を取得\n    pub fn collaboration_store(&amp;self) -&gt; Arc&lt;CollaborationStore&gt; {\n        self.collaboration_store.clone()\n    }\n\n    /// Codex MCP Serverをstdio モードで起動\n    async fn spawn_codex_mcp_server(&amp;self) -&gt; Result&lt;Arc&lt;RmcpClient&gt;&gt; {\n        let codex_path = self\n            .codex_binary_path\n            .clone()\n            .or_else(|| std::env::current_exe().ok())\n            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Codex binary path not configured\"))?;\n\n        info!(\n            \"Spawning Codex MCP Server: {} mcp-server\",\n            codex_path.display()\n        );\n\n        let client = RmcpClient::new_stdio_client(\n            codex_path.into_os_string(),\n            vec![OsString::from(\"mcp-server\")],\n            None,\n            &amp;[],  // env_vars\n            None, // cwd\n        )\n        .await\n        .context(\"Failed to spawn Codex MCP server\")?;\n\n        // Initialize MCP session\n        let init_params = InitializeRequestParams {\n            client_info: mcp_types::Implementation {\n                name: \"codex-subagent-runtime\".to_string(),\n                version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string(),\n                title: None,\n                user_agent: None,\n            },\n            protocol_version: \"0.1.0\".to_string(),\n            capabilities: mcp_types::ClientCapabilities {\n                elicitation: None,\n                experimental: None,\n                sampling: None,\n                roots: None,\n            },\n        };\n\n        let send_elicitation: SendElicitation =\n            Box::new(|_request_id: RequestId, _elicitation: Elicitation| {\n                async move { anyhow::bail!(\"Elicitation not supported in AgentRuntime\") }.boxed()\n            });\n        client\n            .initialize",

        "contents": " {\n        let rows = sqlx::query(\n            r#\"\n            SELECT id, organization_id, user_id, role, joined_at\n            FROM members\n            WHERE organization_id = ?\n            \"#,\n        )\n        .bind(org_id)\n        .fetch_all(&amp;*self.pool)\n        .await?;\n\n        let members: Vec&lt;Member&gt; = rows\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|row| {\n                let joined_secs = row.get::&lt;i64, _&gt;(4) as u64;\n                Member {\n                    id: row.get(0),\n                    organization_id: row.get(1),\n                    user_id: row.get(2),\n                    role: row.get(3),\n                    joined_at: SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH + std::time::Duration::from_secs(joined_secs),\n                }\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        Ok(members)\n    }\n\n    /// Check if user is a member of an organization\n    pub async fn is_member(&amp;self, org_id: &amp;str, user_id: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;bool&gt; {\n        let row = sqlx::query(\n            r#\"\n            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members\n            WHERE organization_id = ? AND user_id = ?\n            \"#,\n        )\n        .bind(org_id)\n        .bind(user_id)\n        .fetch_one(&amp;*self.pool)\n        .await?;\n\n        Ok(row.get::&lt;i64, _&gt;(0) &gt; 0)\n    }\n\n    /// Get user's role in an organization\n    pub async fn get_user_role(&amp;self, org_id: &amp;str, user_id: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Option&lt;String&gt;&gt; {\n        let row = sqlx::query(\n            r#\"\n            SELECT role FROM members\n            WHERE organization_id = ? AND user_id = ?\n            \"#,\n        )\n        .bind(org_id)\n        .bind(user_id)\n        .fetch_optional(&amp;*self.pool)\n        .await?;\n\n        Ok(row.map(|r| r.get(0)))\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "impl McpCodexClient {\n    /// Spawn a new Codex MCP server and connect to it\n    pub async fn spawn(workspace_dir: &amp;PathBuf) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        info!(\"Spawning Codex MCP server for sub-agent\");\n\n        // Spawn &#96;codex mcp-server&#96; as child process\n        let mut process = Command::new(\"codex\")\n            .arg(\"mcp-server\")\n            .current_dir(workspace_dir)\n            .stdin(Stdio::piped())\n            .stdout(Stdio::piped())\n            .stderr(Stdio::inherit())\n            .spawn()\n            .context(\"Failed to spawn codex mcp-server\")?;\n\n        let stdin = process.stdin.take().context(\"Failed to get stdin\")?;\n        let stdout = process.stdout.take().context(\"Failed to get stdout\")?;\n        let stdout = BufReader::new(stdout);\n\n        debug!(\"Codex MCP server spawned successfully\");\n\n        Ok(Self {\n            _process: process,\n            stdin,\n            stdout,\n            next_id: 1,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Call a Codex tool via MCP\n    pub async fn call_tool(&amp;mut self, tool_name: &amp;str, arguments: Value) -&gt; Result&lt;Value&gt; {\n        let request_id = self.next_id;\n        self.next_id += 1;",

        "contents": "    scorer: CompetitionScorer,\n}\n\nimpl CompetitionRunner {\n    /// Create a new competition runner\n    pub fn new(config: CompetitionConfig, repo_root: PathBuf) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt;         "contents": "codex --sandbox read-only\n\n# Allow the agent to write within the current workspace while still blocking network access\ncodex --sandbox workspace-write\n\n# Danger! Disable sandboxing entirely (only do this if you are already running in a container or other isolated env)\ncodex --sandbox danger-full-access\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe same setting can be persisted in &#96;~/.codex/config.toml&#96; via the top-level &#96;sandbox_mode = \"MODE\"&#96; key, e.g. &#96;sandbox_mode = \"workspace-write\"&#96;.\n\n## Code Organization\n\nThis folder is the root of a Cargo workspace. It contains quite a bit of experimental code, but here are the key crates:\n\n- [&#96;core/&#96;](./core) contains the business logic for Codex. Ultimately, we hope this to be a library crate that is generally useful for building other Rust/native applications that use Codex.\n- [&#96;exec/&#96;](./exec) \"headless\" CLI for use in automation.\n- [&#96;tui/&#96;](./tui) CLI that launches a fullscreen TUI built with [Ratatui](https://ratatui.rs/).\n- [&#96;cli/&#96;](./cli) CLI multitool that provides the aforementioned CLIs via subcommands.",

        "contents": "# Codex Project Overview\n\n## Purpose\nCodex is an AI-Native Operating System with 4D Git Visualization &amp; VR/AR Support. It's a Rust-based AI development platform that integrates multiple AI models, MCP servers, and provides advanced features like sub-agent orchestration, deep research capabilities, and cross-platform compatibility.\n\n## Tech Stack\n- **Language**: Rust 2024 edition\n- **Build System**: Cargo workspace with multiple crates\n- **Key Dependencies**: \n  - Async runtime (tokio, async-trait)\n  - MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers\n  - OpenTelemetry for tracing\n  - TUI libraries (ratatui)\n  - HTTP clients (reqwest)\n- **Platforms**: Windows, macOS, Linux, VR/AR support\n\n## Extended Features (zapabob/codex)\n- **Sub-Agent System**: Multi-agent orchestration with parallel execution (2.6x speedup)\n- **Deep Research Engine**: Multi-source research with citation management (45x speedup)\n- **MCP Server Extensions**: 7 additional tools and enhanced integration\n- **Orchestration Framework**: Advanced async execution patterns\n- **Cross-platform Sandboxing**: Enhanced Windows, macOS, Linux support\n\n## Code Structure\n- &#96;core/&#96;: Core functionality and orchestration\n- &#96;cli/&#96;: Command-line interface\n- &#96;tui/&#96;: Terminal user interface\n- &#96;app-server/&#96;: Backend server\n- &#96;mcp-server/&#96;: MCP server implementation\n- &#96;deep-research/&#96;: Research engine\n- &#96;agents/&#96;: Sub-agent system\n- Various utility crates and integrations\n\n## Development Commands\n- &#96;just fmt&#96;: Format code with rustfmt\n- &#96;just fix&#96;: Run clippy with auto-fix\n- &#96;just clippy&#96;: Run clippy linting\n- &#96;just test&#96;: Run tests with cargo-nextest\n- &#96;cargo check --all-features&#96;: Check compilation\n- &#96;cargo build --release&#96;: Release build\n- &#96;cargo install --path codex-rs/cli --force&#96;: Install CLI\n\n## Windows-Specific Notes\n- Use PowerShell instead of bash\n- Commands like &#96;cd codex-rs &amp;&amp; cargo check --all-features&#96; should be split (PowerShell doesn't support &amp;&amp;)\n- Build artifacts go to &#96;target/&#96; directory (should be in .gitignore)\n- Use &#96;cargo install&#96; for installing binaries",
